basis: baseline-v3 medians (2026-09-15: three counted perf sessions on the converged macOS app after the last legacy screen left in CONV-22, Mac mini M2 8 GB, English pinned, runs macos-xcui-perf-20260915-220611-0bb33592, macos-xcui-perf-20260915-221935-636488c2, macos-xcui-perf-20260915-222752-64610737).
